**Digimon Tamers: Digimon Medley** is Bandai's 2001 Digimon game for the WonderSwan Color, released only in Japan. Impmon has kidnapped Calumon, and Takato, Rika or Henry chase him with their partner through the stories of Digimon Adventure and Digimon Adventure 02, episode by episode, teaming up with the kids of those series. Battles are short minigames.

This patch translates it into English.

> **Please read:** this translation was made **entirely with AI**, as a personal project. It is shared as it is for anyone who wants to play, but it must **never be uploaded to romhacking sites** (romhacking.net and the like): it isn't up to the standard of a real fan translation and it doesn't belong there.

**How it was made**

* **Claude** found the game's text formats in the ROM, extracted every Japanese text (3,483 entries) and translated it directly from the Japanese of the WonderSwan Color game, keeping the same meaning and tone.
* **ChatGPT** reviewed it line by line against the Japanese (meaning, tone, names, English) and proposed 30 changes; **Claude** checked every suggestion again against the Japanese and the game and applied 23 of them.
* For v0.9.2, **ChatGPT** reviewed the whole script again against the Japanese, in 25 blocks; **Claude** checked each suggestion and updated 126 dialogue texts.
* **Claude** also did all the ROM hacking (text engine, font, text insertion, graphics) and the emulator tests; /u/Gio-74 did only a final check.
